label_rule: READY: spec present, concrete action and target, no deferral/gating marker. NOT_READY: explicit deferral / no-action / fixture / approval-gated marker (priority, including action-bearing 'hard' negatives), or descriptive-only with no spec and no action verb. Ambiguous cards manually excluded.

disk-trend-watch.py uses a flat CRIT 90% and ignores declared max_root_disk_percent (85 on dell/omen/mn01). tony-dell at 88% is missed. Add per-host threshold + 15 GiB absolute floor + underused signal.

The dispatch prompt is the highest-blast-radius, lowest-verification artifact in the system: rails and primer merge on anecdote while micro-models get golden/hard/adversarial gates. Add a regression suite that pins build_task's contract plus a byte-budget tripwire on rail accretion.

The KK-Mac worker eventually processed new packages, but a single --once scan took several minutes over 25+ Drive packs before claiming newly staged work. Make queue discovery bounded and prompt without weakening claim/fallback gates.

Cards currently open with note/spec jargon. Add a `brief` field — 2-3 sentences of plain language: what's the situation and what Tony's expected action is (review / answer a request / wait / nothing). Expected action on this card: none — dispatch will implement it.

Done column has 1000+ cards (~6.6MB cards.json polled per client). Define and implement a retention procedure: archive stale done cards to a separate store/page, keep board fast and searchable.

2026-10-12 incident: the OR bridge key hit limit_remaining=$0 with ZERO warning — inference 403s fleet-wide until noticed in a manual sweep. leak-detection-canary (proposed) covers leaked keys, not expiry/quota — different job. Build scripts/ops/key-watch.py + systemd timer on tony-dell.

The lesson-polish audit is one-shot. Make it recurring: a nest job (e.g. weekly) runs the lesson-polish pack, and any new R1/R3/R4 flags get routed to the Fable polish pass automatically — the education system audits + fixes itself.

Standard procedure to scan all lesson CPT posts and polish/complete per policy (lesson-capture duty, split rule, series convention, spaced review, Thai). Run nest-style as a Drive pack with an agent lane.

Self-reported lessons are unverified and never retire — the feedback loop has no damping. Build scripts/board/lesson_qc.py: an advisory QC pass over the lesson corpus that clusters near-duplicates, flags stale/contradicting lines, and publishes a report. Advisory only — it never deletes.

Give the shared MediaWiki instance a private in-house hostname and identity-based login so Ada HA can open Infrastructure pages without a second manual login, while public News remains anonymous-safe.

Surface probable canonical updates hidden in extract drafts as reviewable proposals — never auto-write. Builds on memory-distill + consolidate-memory; closes the ADA-0478 leg-3 gap without giving up the human review gate on memory writes.
Formalize how Ada memory banks map onto the two HA lanes so household members get shared+private memory, Tony gets his private banks, and staging/test traffic can't pollute production memory.

3 review cards carry 15-18 duplicate merge-conflict-* requests. open_conflict_req() counts only UNANSWERED ones, so once a human answers, the next 15-min pass posts a fresh request. Gate on conflict signature (head + paths), not answer state.

merge-sweep marked nest-manager-node verified because its branch merged — but the dispatch unit exited 1s in (empty DEVIN_MODEL) and produced nothing. verified should mean the card's expected_goals/auto_done_when checks pass or the outcome doc exists, not just "branch in master".

Turn nest-mgr from observer-governor into a controlled actuator that safely restarts failed nodes and routes eligible queued work to idle hosts — without bypassing owner/quota/leash gates. Build on the v1 census and the devnest-capacity-aware-dispatch lane machinery.

The chaba-nest CMS hub renders lanes + bench scorecards but is invisible to the report node registry — no meta.yml, no staleness, no SYSTEM-REPORT presence, no runtime telemetry. Register the nodes and close the telemetry gap.
